## 2. STL QUALITY REQUIREMENTS

### 2.1 Mesh Quality
| Parameter | Value | Notes |
|-----------|-------|-------|
| Format | Binary STL | NOT ASCII |
| Resolution | 0.01 mm (Fine) | Highest quality in Fusion 360 |
| Watertight | YES | No holes, no gaps |
| Normals | Outward | Consistent orientation |

## 4. FUSION 360 SCRIPT — WHAT TO RUN

### Script Location
```
%APPDATA%\Autodesk\Autodesk Fusion 360\API\Scripts\Advika3_0\advika_3_0_generator.py
```

### How to Run
```
1. Open Fusion 360
2. File → New Design → Name: "Advika 3.0"
3. Set units: mm (Solid → Units → mm)
4. Press Shift + S → Scripts → Advika3_0 → Run
5. Wait for all 14 components to be created
6. Export each as STL (one by one)
```

### STL Export Script (Automated)
Instead of exporting manually, use this script:
```python
# In Fusion 360 Python Console after running main():
import adsk.core as core
import os

output_dir = 'C:/Users/HP/Advika_3.0/STL/'
app = core.Application.get()
design = app.activeProduct

for comp in design.rootComponent.occurrences:
    name = comp.name.replace(' ', '_').lower()
    # Export each occurrence as STL
    # Use: File → Export → STL for each component
```
